يتناغم (form VI)
# يَتَنَاغَمُ (yatanāḡamu) /ja.ta.naː.ɣa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# يَتَنَاغَمَ (yatanāḡama) /ja.ta.naː.ɣa.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# يَتَنَاغَمْ (yatanāḡam) /ja.ta.naː.ɣam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
